title: HydroRack Sink System
description: High-energy e-commerce motion ad demonstrating expandable over-the-sink colander functionality, vegetable washing, and quick-dry dish draining.
overview: Crafted a fast-paced Amazon and TikTok DTC video highlighting the 'Prep · Rinse · Drain' workflow with running tap water, fresh produce, and draining glassware.
challenge: Simulating convincing fluid dynamics and real water interaction without expensive high-speed camera equipment and messy studio sets.
solution: Synthesized high-speed fluid motion in Luma and Runway Gen-3 with custom physical splash masks, finalized with bold commercial text animations in After Effects.
